positions.title: Co-Founder and Head of Mobile Development
positions.description:
nello unlocks the service economy by upgrading existing intercom systems. 

We enable keyless entry for residents and their service providers by offering apartment dwellers upgrade solutions for their existing intercoms. nello builds nello one - an easy to upgrade hardware solution that enables keyless entry to apartment buildings, easily managed through the nello app. nello one is integrated with leading smart locks and the service economy to provide a fully integrated keyless solution for apartment dwellers.

positions.title: Visiting Scholar
positions.description: Worked on a project that focused on gait analysis and fall prevention in the elderly. The goal of the project was to develop and evaluate a gait analysis system that detects gait abnormalities induced by the onset of muscle fatigue, in order to reduce the risk of falling in older people. For the accomplishment of this goal, mobile devices and wearable sensors are used. The setup consisted of a Machine Learning system, an iOS app and Arduino microcontrollers connected to the pressure sensors and IMUs in the shoes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Interdisciplinary project during which I developed a solution for assessing patients' physical functional status in clinical settings using acceleration data and mobile devices. The solution consisted of a web application and an Android app for patient data management, processing and visualisation as well as a Texas Instruments SensorTag for data collection.

company.name: Netlight
company.tagline: Transforming ideas into reality in the digital landscape.
company.description:
Netlight is an international digital consulting firm, helping leading companies to succeed in the digital landscape, from advice to implementation. Our ambition is to co-create and be an augmented partner to our clients as they explore the digital landscape. 

Our clients range from industry-leading enterprises to disruptive startups turning into unicorns. Trusted with their challenges, we have built a unique experience since 1999 in how to approach the uncharted digital landscape and go from idea to reality, together.

We strive to be role models — conscious of positive change at the forefront of society's digital transformation. Creativity thrives in an inclusive and diverse culture. Together with our ambitious clients, we engage in challenges to make a sustainable impact. 

Netlight is located in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo, Copenhagen, Amsterdam, Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, Cologne, Zurich, Frankfurt, London, Toronto, Gothenburg, and Madrid.
